tasks.goal: Guide visitors along the charter exhibits, narrating the DAO's mission and measurable outcomes while stopping at each display panel.
tasks.terrain: Flat polished exhibit floor with pedestal displays and cabling ramps; low-friction surface requires short strides.
success: Visits all exhibit waypoints in order within 12 minutes
Speech playback triggered at 100% of waypoints
No contact forces above 5 N on any pedestal
safety_stops: Stop if obstacle within 0.3 m on path
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward approves the final tour script before public playback.

tasks.goal: Retrieve labeled research binders from shelf locations and deliver them to the synthesis desk for the Evidence Monitor's daily summary.
tasks.terrain: Carpeted lab aisles 1.2 m wide with rolling chairs and boxed archive crates as ground clutter.
success: Picks 8 of 10 requested binders without drops
Delivery accuracy within 0.15 m of desk target
safety_stops: Torque limit abort at 40 Nm on arm joints
Stop when human detected within 0.8 m of arm envelope
Wheel slip fault halt on carpet drag > 15%
tasks.human_in_loop: A researcher confirms each requested binder ID before the pick run.

tasks.goal: Carry printed proposal drafts from the drafting station to reviewer seating pods, signaling arrival so human reviewers can vote.
tasks.terrain: Open forum floor with tiered seating steps at edges, floor outlets, and lightweight folding chairs that shift positions daily.
success: Mean positional error under 0.25 m at pods
Remains stable on steps detection (no tip events)
safety_stops: Stop on step edge detection within 0.2 m
Payload tilt > 25 degrees triggers gentle set-down
tasks.human_in_loop: People at the pods accept each delivery and trigger the return command; the robot never enacts proposals.

tasks.goal: Patrol the operations floor on a fixed route inspecting working-group station status tags and reporting anomalies to the Task Router dashboard.
tasks.terrain: Driftless-area grassland outside the deck doors: uneven prairie turf, rutted gravel service path, and seasonal snow patches; indoors is concrete.
success: Completes 2 km patrol loop with localization error under 0.5 m
Captures legible QR status tags at 95% of stations
Anomaly report published within 60 s of detection
safety_stops: Roll-over risk halt at roll angle > 20 degrees
Wheel slip > 30% on gravel pauses and alerts
Geofence breach beyond deck perimeter triggers stop
tasks.human_in_loop: An operator reviews flagged anomalies before any maintenance ticket is filed.

tasks.goal: Climb the observatory mezzanine stair and calibrate progress-metric sensor mounts against fixed reference markers on the tracking wall.
tasks.terrain: Steel-grid mezzanine stairs with 18 cm risers, then flat observation deck with glass railing edges and tripod mounts as obstacles.
success: Stair ascent with zero slips detected
Calibration poses achieved within 2 cm and 3 degrees of targets
No contact with glass railing during 10 poses
safety_stops: Autonomous sit-down on slip detection > 10 cm displacement
Boundary stop 0.5 m from railing edges
Comms loss > 5 s triggers hold position
tasks.human_in_loop: A technician verifies each calibration pose and authorizes stair descent.

tasks.goal: Fly a lawnmower-pattern scan of the Charter Hall ceiling exhibits to build a 3D model of the charter display layout for the Progress Tracker.
tasks.terrain: High open hall with hanging charter banners, pendant light fixtures at 4 m, and door drafts at the main entrance.
success: Completes full hall scan grid in under 10 minutes
Map coverage above 90% of ceiling exhibit area
No positional loss events during flight
safety_stops: Land immediately if wall distance under 0.5 m
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward clears the airspace and approves each flight plan before launch.
